parsed_json.up: Select compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, standard type, standard relation, standard value, standard units, activity comment, target ChEMBL ID, target name, and target organism. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, then to target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures on molregno as an INNER JOIN to enforce SMILES presence. Join compound_records on activities.record_id and docs on compound_records.doc_id to obtain compound_key and pubmed_id/doi. Filter for target CHEMBL1855 and standard_type IC50. Keep only rows where canonical_smiles is present and either pubmed_id or doi is present. Return all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
